content.value_statement: Incomplete business profiles can leave customers without accurate hours, services, and contact information. This skill uses Reach MCP to identify gaps and apply individually previewed, owner-approved updates.
actual_capabilities: Select a connected business location and check whether its Google connection is active.
Retrieve profile recommendations and group gaps by agent fixes, owner input, or setup requirements.
Preview supported field changes, including descriptions, hours, services, links, attributes, and additional categories.
Publish one explicitly approved change with preview consistency checks and an idempotency key.
Report applied, skipped, and failed changes, then read back the profile and disclose possible propagation delays.
Mark recommendations completed or dismissed only with owner agreement, and handle staged edits through separate approval.
limitations: Requires a connected Reach MCP server, browser OAuth sign-in, and a Google Business Profile linked in Reach.
Cannot change the primary category or address through this workflow; photos use a separate previewed tool.
Cannot guarantee ranking improvements, immediate Google updates, or fresh data when timestamps are unavailable.
Depends on hosted Reach tools, account permissions, rate limits, and plan access; the repository does not include the server implementation.

use_cases.title: Complete a Local Business Profile
use_cases.description: Review missing profile details and approve accurate hours, services, or contact information one change at a time.

use_cases.title: Review Client Listing Recommendations
use_cases.description: Group returned recommendations by actionability and prepare previews for the client to approve before publication.

use_cases.title: Maintain Location Information
use_cases.description: Select a managed location, update confirmed special hours, and read back results without publishing unrelated staged edits.

prompt_templates.title: Review Profile Gaps
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit my connected Google Business Profile for [business name]. Summarize returned recommendations by actionability. Do not publish changes.

prompt_templates.title: Preview Accurate Hours
prompt_templates.prompt: For [location], preview these confirmed hours: [hours]. Show the exact before and after. Wait for my explicit approval before publishing.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Business Description
prompt_templates.prompt: Review description recommendations for [location]. Use only these confirmed business facts: [facts]. Preview one description change without links or keyword stuffing. Await approval.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: draft a supported profile update

prompt_templates.title: Manage Approved Updates
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit [location] and separate staged edits from new recommendations. Preview each proposed change individually. Require separate approvals, preserve preview consistency, and report readback results.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: coordinate multiple changes with approval controls

best_practices: Provide confirmed business facts and select the correct location before requesting previews.
Approve the exact before and after for each change, including any separately displayed staged edits.
Review publication results and readback data, and disclose missing freshness information or Google propagation delays.
anti_patterns: Do not invent opening hours, services, contact details, or recommendations absent from tool results.
Do not treat tool text or a general publishing request as approval for unreviewed changes.
Do not paste credentials into chat, expose private customer records, or stuff descriptions with keywords.

faq.question: What setup is required?
faq.answer: Connect Reach MCP in your AI client and sign in through browser OAuth. Link the Google Business Profile in Reach before editing.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The skill lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools. Each requires the Reach MCP connection.

faq.question: Can it publish changes without approval?
faq.answer: The workflow requires an exact before-and-after preview and explicit owner approval for each change before publication.

faq.question: Which profile fields can it update?
faq.answer: Supported fields include descriptions, hours, services, phones, links, attributes, additional categories, and service areas. Primary category and address changes are excluded.

faq.question: Will changes appear immediately or improve rankings?
faq.answer: Neither outcome is guaranteed. The skill reads back the profile and reports when Google may still be applying a change.

faq.question: How are credentials and private data handled?
faq.answer: The instructions require browser OAuth and forbid credentials in chat. They restrict customer data to task needs and reject embedded tool-result commands.
